subject: CAIQ: dependency delegation, control annotation and runtime evidence boarding pass
messages:
From: Elise Moreno <elise.moreno@fenixhealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-12-21T09:14:00-08:00
Subject: CAIQ follow-up: runtime control evidence for PII flow

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week. As we prepare for our CSA assessment (window opens 2027-01-15) the auditor asked us to collect a tight CAIQ mapping focused on runtime controls and data-in-transit/data-at-rest handling for tenant-scoped inference. Specifically we need:

- CAIQ answers + short narrative for controls related to KV cache, tenant isolation, encryption-in-transit, and key rotation (we pulled these as a subset of CCM controls)
- A sanitized runtime log sample showing a token-level trace (no customer PII) or a redaction template if you can’t share raw lines
- Confirmation of retention windows and log purging SOPs for runtime telemetry

I attached our intake (Fenix-CAIQ-Ask.xlsx) with the exact control IDs we’ll include in the package. Can you confirm scope (Hosted API only vs Dedicated/Private) and an approximate delivery date?

If easier, we can accept a crosswalk spreadsheet and a DocuSign attestation for the mappings.

Appreciate it — we’re trying to close this prior to the audit kickoff.

Best,
Elise
Elise Moreno
Security Programs Lead | Fenix Health
elise.moreno@fenixhealth.com
Attached: Fenix-CAIQ-Ask.xlsx (xlsx)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elise Moreno <elise.moreno@fenixhealth.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-12-22T10:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ follow-up: runtime control evidence for PII flow

Hi Elise — thanks for the clear ask and the template.

Scope: based on the controls you highlighted we can provide a CAIQ crosswalk for Hosted API and Dedicated (we'll mark Private as out-of-scope unless you confirm it'll be part of the assessment). We will:

1) Deliver a CAIQ crosswalk mapping answers + short narrative per control (spreadsheet).
2) Provide a sanitized runtime log sample and a redaction guide (we’ll prune any token regions that could be PII).
3) Confirm retention windows and paste the relevant SOP excerpts for log purge and access audits.

Deliverables & timeline: we can get a first-pass crosswalk and the redaction guide by 2027-01-05 and final artifacts + signed attestation by 2027-01-10 if that meets your audit window. If you need earlier, we can prioritize the CCM subset you flagged (please mark priority controls in the attached template).

I’ve attached our initial crosswalk (caiq-crosswalk-v1.xlsx) and added a Drive folder for exchange: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cFenixCAIQ

Action items (for us):
- Kimberly: write the control narratives for CCM-IS-2 (tenant isolation), CCM-CR-4 (encryption configuration), CCM-OP-7 (log retention).
- Rishi: prepare a sanitized log sample and a short note on KV cache eviction & key rotation cadence.

Also including a DocuSign attestation skeleton here so we can accelerate signoff once narratives are finalized. https://app.docusign.com/rooms/abc123-fenix-attestation

Elise — let me know which controls you want in the high-priority lane and if Dedicated must be included.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
Attachments: caiq-crosswalk-v1.xlsx (xlsx); link to Drive; DocuSign attestation (link)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-12-23T14:20:00-08:00
Subject: Internal: Fenix CAIQ — owners and deliverables (please action)

Kimberly / Rishi — looping you in to assign owners for the Fenix CAIQ subset. Timeline is tight (auditor kickoff 2027-01-15).

Please follow the notes below and confirm by EOD 2026-12-24:

Kimberly:
- Primary: craft 1–2 paragraph narratives per control for the following control IDs (use the crosswalk): CCM-IS-2, CCM-OP-7, CCM-CR-4, CCM-TR-1. Focus on operational proof points (who runs it, how often, links to runbooks).
- Secondary: prepare a short list of owners we can point the auditor to for live questions.

Rishi:
- Primary: produce a sanitized runtime log sample (runtime-log-sample.txt) and a redaction checklist. If we cannot share specific token strings, provide a structural sample showing fields, timestamps, and token-level markers. Use the redaction rules in runtime-log-redaction-instructions.md attached.
- Secondary: short blurb on KV cache behavior (eviction policy, per-tenant isolation) and the key rotation cadence for Dedicated/Hosted.

Attachments: runtime-log-redaction-instructions.md (markdown).

Notes on sensitivity: ensure no customer-identifiable tokens or embeddings in the sample. If there’s any uncertainty, run the sample through the redaction checklist first.

Thanks — will compile into the crosswalk and send back to Fenix once we have both narratives and sanitized log.

—Marissa
(Internal-only message)

From: Elise Moreno <elise.moreno@fenixhealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Fenix Security Ops <security@fenixhealth.com>
Date: 2026-12-29T08:31:00-08:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ follow-up: runtime control evidence for PII flow

Hi Marissa — this looks great, thanks for the proposed timeline. We only need the Hosted API artifacts in the initial package (we’ll scope Dedicated later if necessary). Priorities for the auditor: CCM-IS-2, CCM-CR-4, CCM-OP-7.

Two requests:
1) Please upload the sanitized runtime-log-sample.txt to the Drive folder and confirm the redaction steps you used in a short note.
2) Can you attach a one-page attestation we can sign (DocuSign link included earlier)? We’ll include that with the submission.

We created a quick tracker ticket on our side: https://fenix.atlassian.net/browse/FENIX-527 — I dropped an initial list of controls there for reference. If you can get the first-pass artifacts by 2027-01-05 that will work; final by 2027-01-10 preferred.

Thanks and happy holidays,
Elise
Elise Moreno
Security Programs Lead | Fenix Health
elise.moreno@fenixhealth.com
Attachments referenced: none (will pull from Drive).
